name: How do I choose a gate repair company in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a gate repair company in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a gate repair company in the East Bay area, look for one with local experience, positive customer reviews, and transparent pricing. Ensure they are licensed and insured, and that they specialize in the type of gate you need repaired. Ask for a detailed estimate and inquire about their warranty on parts and labor. Frasheski Construction has served Berkeley, Oakland, Albany, and El Cerrito, with a focus on quality and customer satisfaction.
